## Data Cleaning. and Preperation

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE) 
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr) 
library(knitr)
```

### Load the merged dataset (assumed to be in the working directory)

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
df <- read.csv("wdi_fifa_merged.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
```

### Specify model variables

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
model_vars <- c( 
  "fifa_rank", #Response: Mean annual FIFA ranking (1 = best) 
  "qualified", #Categorical predictor 1: World Cup qualification 
  "income", #Categorical predictor 2: Income group (4 levels) 
  "life_exp", #Continuous predictor 1: Life expectancy at birth
  "log_gdp_pc", #Continuous predictor 2: Log GDP per capita 
  "urban",  #Continuous predictor 3: Urban population percentage 
  "unemp", #Continuous predictor 4: Unemployment rate 
  "lfp_female", #Continuous predictor 5: Female labor force participation
  "pop_growth", #Continuous predictor 6: Annual population growth rate 
  "temp", #Continuous predictor 7: Mean temperature 
  "health_exp" #Continuous predictor 8: Health expenditure (% of GDP) 
  )
```

### Clean data, factorize categorical variables, and keep complete cases

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
df_clean <- df %>% 
  mutate( 
    qualified_cat = factor(qualified, levels = c(0, 1)), 
    income = factor(income, levels = c( "High income", "Low income", "Lower middle income", "Upper middle income" )) 
    ) %>% 
    select(country, year, all_of(model_vars), qualified_cat) %>% 
    drop_na()
```

### Save cleaned dataset for project submission

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
write.csv(df_clean, "wdi_fifa_clean.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```

### Check sample size and categorical distributions

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
dim(df_clean)
table(Qualified = df_clean$qualified_cat)
table(Income_Group = df_clean$income)
```

## Summary Statistics

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
num_vars <- c("fifa_rank", "life_exp", "log_gdp_pc", "urban", "unemp",
              "lfp_female", "pop_growth", "temp", "health_exp")

summary_stats <- df_clean %>%
  summarise(across(all_of(num_vars), list(
    Mean   = ~mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE),
    SD     = ~sd(.x, na.rm = TRUE),
    Median = ~median(.x, na.rm = TRUE),
    IQR    = ~IQR(.x, na.rm = TRUE),
    Min    = ~min(.x, na.rm = TRUE),
    Max    = ~max(.x, na.rm = TRUE)
  ), .names = "{.col}__{.fn}")) %>%
  pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = c("Variable", ".value"), names_sep = "__")

kable(
  summary_stats,
  digits = 2,
  caption = "Summary statistics for FIFA ranking and continuous predictors (n = 1,825)."
)
```


## Preliminary Model Fitting

### Model
```{r setup, include=FALSE}
prelim_model <- lm(
  fifa_rank ~ qualified_cat * life_exp + log_gdp_pc + income +
    urban + unemp + lfp_female + pop_growth + temp + health_exp,
  data = df_clean
)

summary(prelim_model)
```

### OLS Estimates, Std Errors, and 95% CI intervals
```{r setup, include=FALSE}
coef_mat <- summary(prelim_model)$coefficients
ci_mat   <- confint(prelim_model, level = 0.95)

model_table <- data.frame(
  Predictor = rownames(coef_mat),
  Estimate  = round(coef_mat[, "Estimate"], 2),
  SE        = round(coef_mat[, "Std. Error"], 2),
  CI_Lower  = round(ci_mat[, 1], 2),
  CI_Upper  = round(ci_mat[, 2], 2),
  t_stat    = round(coef_mat[, "t value"], 2),
  p_value   = ifelse(coef_mat[, "Pr(>|t|)"] < 0.001, "< 0.001", 
                     round(coef_mat[, "Pr(>|t|)"], 3)),
  row.names = NULL
)

kable(
  model_table,
  caption = "OLS estimates, standard errors, and 95% CIs for preliminary model (n = 1,825)."
)
```

### Residual Plots
```{r setup, include=FALSE}

# Display directly in the knitted document
par(mfrow = c(1, 4), mar = c(4.5, 4.5, 2.5, 1.5))
plot(prelim_model, which = c(1, 2, 3, 5))
par(mfrow = c(1, 1))
```
